assessment.label: unbalance
assessment.reason: Query shows dominant shaft 1x on all 4 channels (0.0126, 0.00788, 0.01073, 0.00730) with low 2x (0.0009-0.0033) and very low 3x (0.00012-0.00035). This matches labelled unbalance trials where 1x is ~0.004-0.015 and >>2x, e.g. unbalance reference with 1x 0.0154/0.0089/0.0129/0.0085, vs normal/misalignment where 1x is ~0.0003-0.0015 and misalignment shows dominant 2x ~0.011-0.015 on ch0/ch2. RMS ~0.034-0.038, crest ~4.7-7.3, kurtosis ~3.0-3.8 also align with unbalance references and not the high kurtosis/crest normal examples. Limitation: looseness references also show elevated 1x of similar magnitude, and radial signals plus one short recording cannot fully exclude looseness; 3x is low which favors unbalance over the looseness example with high 3x, but distinction remains imperfect.
